title: Seek the Lord and Live

questions.question: Seek the Lord and live, lest he break out like fire in the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:6 (ESV): "Seek the Lord and live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph,"

questions.question: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the Lord, the God of hosts, will be with you, as you have what?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:14 (ESV): "and so the Lord, the God of hosts, will be with you, as you have said."

questions.question: Hate evil, and love good, and establish justice in the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:15 (ESV): "Hate evil, and love good, and establish justice in the gate;"

questions.question: Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing what?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:24 (ESV): "But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream."

questions.question: Fallen, no more to rise, is the virgin who?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:2 (ESV): "Fallen, no more to rise, is the virgin Israel;"

questions.question: Do not seek Bethel, and do not enter into Gilgal or cross over to where?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:5 (ESV): "and do not enter into Gilgal or cross over to Beersheba;"

questions.question: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns deep darkness into the morning, and darkens the day into night... the Lord is his name.
questions.explanation: Amos 5:8 (ESV): "He who made the Pleiades and Orion..."

questions.question: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:10 (ESV): "and they abhor him who speaks the truth."

questions.question: You have built houses of hewn stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their what?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:11 (ESV): "you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine."

questions.question: Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:25 (ESV): "Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?" (Rhetorical question implying negative answer in this context).

questions.question: The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out a hundred shall have how many left?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:3 (ESV): "and that which went out a hundred shall have ten left"

questions.question: You trample on the poor and you exact taxes of what from him?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:11 (ESV): "because you trample on the poor and you exact taxes of grain from him,"

questions.question: Woe to you who desire the day of the Lord! Why would you have the day of the Lord? It is darkness, and not light, as if a man fled from a lion, and a what met him?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:19 (ESV): "as if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him,"

questions.question: Take away from me the noise of your songs; to the melody of your what I will not listen?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:23 (ESV): "to the melody of your harps I will not listen."

questions.question: You shall take up Sikkuth your king and Kiyyun your star-god, your images that you made for yourselves, and I will send you into exile beyond where?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:27 (ESV): "and I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,"

key_verse_text: But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
